slides.headline: THE DESK COST $294,000. THE AGENTS COST $2,400
slides.body: Six agents split a desk that cost $294,000 a year. You get the same brief for $2,400. 122 times cheaper

slides.headline: 1) LET ONE AGENT READ EVERY FILING OVERNIGHT
slides.body: You'd pay a junior analyst $180,000 to read these at 2am. FILINGS does it overnight. "Scan every 10-K and 8-K on my watchlist. Flag going concern language or auditor changes"
slides.image_prompt: A chest-high tower of SEC-style paper documents stacked impossibly tall on a bright amber-lit desk, a massive vivid red digital alert triangle icon hovering above the top page like a warning beacon, the stack looming and dense; saturated cobalt blue background, hard amber spotlight casting dramatic shadow from the tower; documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh flash, film grain; accent: signal red against vivid cobalt blue.

slides.headline: 2) LET ONE AGENT CATCH WHEN A CFO GOES QUIET
slides.body: CFOs signal trouble before they announce it. EARNINGS reads the call in 24 hours and flags tone shifts. "Read this earnings call. Was the CFO quieter or vaguer than last quarter?"
slides.image_prompt: A lone corporate podium microphone in tight close-up filling two-thirds of frame, a colossal vivid red mute symbol — bold mic icon with a thick diagonal slash — floating beside the mic head, the silence made physical and unmistakable; bright saturated cobalt blue stage-wash backdrop; documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh flash, film grain; accent: signal red against vivid cobalt blue.

slides.headline: 3) LET ONE AGENT FLAG RULE CHANGES NOBODY READ
slides.body:
Regulators change rules every week. You'll never read them all. SECTOR does.

"Scan this week's regulatory filings for [industry]. Flag any rule change that could change what companies are worth"

slides.headline: 4) LET ONE AGENT WATCH EVERY INSIDER BET OVERNIGHT
slides.body: Insiders bet their own cash first. INSIDER flags every buy over $1 million the day it files. "Scan today's Form 4s. Flag buys over $1M and new positions from Two Sigma, D.E. Shaw"

slides.headline: 5) LET ONE AGENT SPOT THE SOCIAL SPIKE BEFORE IT MOVES
slides.body:
A company that gets 3x louder online usually moves next. CHATTER tells you first.

"Count mentions of [company] on X today. Flag if volume is 3 standard deviations above its 30-day average"

slides.headline: 6) LET ONE AGENT BRIEF YOU ON 3,000 COMPANIES BY 6AM
slides.body: One analyst covers 30 names. CHIEF OF STAFF briefs you on 3,000 by 6am. "Read FILINGS, EARNINGS, SECTOR, INSIDER, CHATTER. Drop anything flagged by only one. Rank the rest. Email by 6am"

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: THE 6 AGENTS THAT REPLACED A $294,000 DESK
slides.body:
FILINGS: reads every SEC filing overnight
EARNINGS: catches CFO tone shifts
SECTOR: flags rule changes overnight
INSIDER: spots $1M hedge fund bets
CHATTER: flags social spikes
CHIEF OF STAFF: 6am ranked brief

caption:
